messages.content: Can I report noise complaint to my local council in city of Atlanta?

function.name: get_law_categories

message.content: Yes, you can report a noise complaint to your local council in Atlanta. Noise complaints are typically handled by the city's code enforcement or public safety departments. In Atlanta, you can file a noise complaint through the City of Atlanta's official website, by calling the Atlanta Police Department’s non-emergency line at 404‑656‑4000, or by visiting your local city hall. The city’s website also offers an online form for reporting noise violations.
